title: 第34章 又亲又摸的也叫治病？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 诸位这是什么意思？是不是有什么误会？”唐逸没敢妄动，平静看着前方缓步走来的锦衣卫千户：“我是在救公主殿下，孔小姐和公主都可以作证。”孔诗岚，萧澜见到这一幕，脸色也变了，也都跑了出来。“宁川，你……咳咳……你想干嘛？”萧澜拦在唐逸面前，瞪着走过来的青年：“他是本公主的救命恩人，你们敢动他？”孔诗岚福身行礼，道：“宁千户，这里面有误会，唐逸是在救公主，而非冒犯公主。”宁川面色冷傲，只是冲着孔诗岚和萧澜拱手道：“公主殿下，孔姑娘，我是奉命行事，还请别为难我。”话落，他手压着绣春刀，看向唐逸道：“唐逸，轻薄公主，蔑视皇族，本官今晚拿你下狱，等候发落。”北镇抚司，那对大炎人来说就是阎王殿。进入北镇抚司的，能活着出来的没有几个人。唐逸手缓缓攥成拳，他是不可能束手就擒的，否则进了北镇抚司，那就是人家案板上的肉！“这……就有点不讲理了啊！”唐逸目光盯着宁川的喉咙，擒贼先擒王，他才有反败为胜的机会。然而宁川早就看穿了他的心思，上前一步按住了他的手，用只能两人听到的声音道：“别挣扎，这是你萧叔的意思。”“你今晚闹得太大，瞒不住，将来肯定被人拿出来说事。”“今晚处理过你了，将来就不会有人敢拿这件事在陛下面前控告你。”萧叔？萧策？唐逸双眼微眯，萧叔这么牛逼？还能指挥动锦衣卫？“兄弟，我们是锦衣卫，给个面子。”“自己走，总比我们为了面子收拾你一顿，押着你走好吧？”宁川手落在唐逸的肩膀上，道：“男人是该有勇气，不过在你面前的，都是能以一敌百的高手，你想试试？”唐逸目光扫了一圈，所有锦衣卫都手押着刀把，跃跃欲试地看着他。唐逸顿时有点愕然，这什么意思？初次见面没惹你们吧？这么大敌意干嘛？“好，我跟你们走。”唐逸点头。一是知道萧策身份不简单，而且对萧策有一定的信任。二是……妈的，锦衣卫这群家伙，不知道为何敌意这么大，都巴不得他动手呢！他虽然很强，奈何这具身体距离他巅峰状态还差得太远，想要压制住这百来个大内顶尖高手，机会渺茫。而且，一旦动手打起来，杀招迭出，势必造成伤亡。这可不是唐逸想要看到的。“唐逸！”萧澜气得跺脚，你知道你在说什么吗？“没事，他们找我有点事而已。”唐逸看向孔诗岚，道：“孔姑娘，麻烦你派人和梁绍说一声，今晚让他帮忙照顾我妹一宿，我明天再去接我妹妹。”孔诗岚微微颔首。看着唐逸被锦衣卫带走，萧澜气得咬牙切齿：“我这就回宫找父皇，他救了我，父皇不能这么不讲理。”“哼，你私自外逃的时候，有没有想过和朕讲理？”炎文帝冰冷的声音传来。萧澜当场吓得一个激灵，回头果然看到炎文帝坐在马车里，正冷冰冰地盯着她。孔诗岚没想到竟然惊动了皇帝，吓得跪下行礼，只是膝盖还没落地，便被陈貂寺扶了起来：“孔小姐，陛下微服出巡，不用行礼。”话落，陈貂寺冲着萧澜拱手道：“公主殿下，请回府吧。”萧澜不敢违抗父亲的话，只得耷拢着脑袋道：“岚姐，我先回去了，过几天再找你玩儿。”皇帝却看向孔诗岚，道：“小女娃，听说你要举办沈园诗会，对抗朕的指婚？”孔诗岚娇躯微微一僵，随即福身行礼道：“回陛下，臣女……臣女的婚事，臣女想自己做主。”“自己做主？”炎文帝眼睛微微眯了起来。孔诗岚咬着薄唇，婚姻大事，父母之命媒妁之言，何况这是陛下指婚。她知道自己的话，有多大逆不道。但孔诗岚还是坚定了自己的想法，道：“是，臣女的婚事，臣女想自己做主。”“父皇，岚姐的婚事，你就让他自己做主嘛。”萧澜假装咳得上气不接下气，道：“父皇指婚，又不知道对方品行如何，指婚要是岚姐过不好怎么办？”炎文帝瞪了一眼萧澜，没理会女儿拙劣的演技，道：“若指婚唐逸呢？”萧澜猛地抬起头，啊？那是我孩子他爹呀父皇。孔诗岚心头有一丝犹豫，但很快便坚定下来：“臣女还是那句话，臣女的婚事，臣女想自己做主。”炎文帝闻言笑了起来。他指尖轻轻敲着马车船沿，片刻才道：“好，朕准了。既然要办，沈园诗会不要用你的名义，用你爷爷的名义吧！”“办大一点，最好将京都豪门，权贵，都请到场。”“而且，朕还答应你，沈园诗会结束后，朕会收回成命，不再给你指婚。”孔诗岚心中顿时翻江倒海，震撼无比。他爷爷可是当今大炎文坛领袖，大炎过半的官员都是他的学生，以他的名义，那京都权贵、豪族都会悉数到场。但她不明白的是，皇帝为什么要这么做？“朕也会亲临！”听到这话，孔诗岚脑袋顿时嗡嗡作响。皇帝也会亲临！她的沈园诗会，某种意义上来说，就是逼皇帝退婚的一种示威……结果，皇帝还同意了她的示威？不但如此，还亲自为她背书？这……到底怎么回事？“臣女……谢陛下。”孔诗岚福了一礼。想不通，那就回去请教爷爷再说。“孔诗岚，你可别后悔啊！”炎文帝放下车帘，马车驶离胭脂楼。萧澜一看顿时急了：“父皇，我还没上车呢，你走了我怎么办？”“你公主府的车驾已经来了，等着他们送你回去。”炎文帝的声音淡漠传来。孔诗岚站在原地，面上依旧带着浓浓的困惑。后悔？后悔什么？她不想接受陛下的指婚，想要自己寻求幸福，有什么好后悔的？而这时，马车中的炎文帝，都快压不住嘴角了。哼哼，不指婚好啊！好男儿自然要留给自家闺女嘛！当然，得等到唐逸这小子，将澜儿治好再说。至于驸马不能有太大的权势？虽然这是千百年来都没变过的规矩，但他不介意变一变。再说只要唐逸这家伙有本事力压群臣，谁敢说半句不是？咳咳，想得太远了，不切实际，不切实际……哈哈哈！
content_en: What do you mean?Is there any misunderstanding?Tang Yi did not dare to move rashly, and calmly looked at Qianhu, the Jin Yiwei who was walking slowly in front of him: "I am saving Her Highness the Princess. Both Miss Kong and the Princess can testify.""When Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan saw this scene, their expressions changed and they ran out. "Ning Chuan, you... ahem... what do you want to do?"Xiao Lan stopped in front of Tang Yi and glared at the young man who came over: "He is my princess's savior, how dare you touch him?Kong Shilan bowed and said: "Ning Qianhu, there is a misunderstanding here. Tang Yi is saving the princess, not offending her."Ning Chuan looked cold and arrogant, but he cupped his hands at Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan and said: "Your Highness, Miss Kong, I am acting under orders, please don't embarrass me."After finishing speaking, he pressed the embroidered spring knife with his hand, looked at Tang Yi and said: "Tang Yi, you are a frivolous princess and despise the royal family. I will put you in jail tonight and wait for your punishment.""Beizhen Fusi, to the people of Dayan, is the Palace of the King of Hell. Few people who entered Beizhen Fusi could come out alive. Tang Yi slowly clenched his hands into fists. He couldn't be captured without restraint, otherwise he would be meat on someone's chopping board after entering Beizhen Fusi! "This... is a bit unreasonable!"Tang Yi stared at Ning Chuan's throat. He wanted to capture the king first, so that he could have a chance to turn defeat into victory. However, Ning Chuan had already seen through his mind, stepped forward, held his hand, and said in a voice that could only be heard by the two of them: "Don't struggle, this is what your Uncle Xiao meant."You made too big a fuss tonight. You can't hide it. Someone will definitely bring it up in the future.""I have dealt with you tonight, and no one will dare to accuse you of this matter in front of His Majesty in the future.""Uncle Xiao? Xiao Ce? Tang Yi narrowed his eyes. Uncle Xiao is so awesome? Can he still command the Jin Yiwei? "Brother, we are Jin Yiwei, give us some face."It's better to leave by yourself than for us to punish you and escort you away just to save face, right?"Ning Chuan put his hand on Tang Yi's shoulder and said, "A man should have courage, but the people in front of you are all masters who can fight one against a hundred. Do you want to give it a try?""Tang Yi glanced around. All the Jinyi guards were holding the handles of their swords and looking at him eagerly. Tang Yi was a little stunned. What does this mean? I didn't offend you when we first met, right? Why are you so hostile? "Okay, I'll go with you."Tang Yi nodded. First, he knew that Xiao Ce's identity was not simple, and he had a certain amount of trust in Xiao Ce. Second,... Damn, the Jin Yiwei guys, I don't know why they are so hostile, and they all want him to do it! Although he is very strong, his body is still far from his peak state. If he wants to suppress these hundreds of top masters, the chance is slim. Moreover, once they start fighting, they will use killing moves one after another, which will inevitably cause casualties. This is not what Tang Yi wants to see. "Tang Yi!"Xiao Lan stomped her feet angrily, do you know what you are talking about? "It's okay, they just have something to do with me.Tang Yi looked at Kong Shilan and said, "Miss Kong, please send someone to tell Liang Shao and ask him to help take care of my sister for one night tonight. I will pick up my sister tomorrow."Kong Shilan nodded slightly. Seeing Tang Yi being taken away by the Jin Yiwei, Xiao Lan was so angry that she gritted her teeth: "I will go back to the palace to find my father. He saved me. My father can't be so unreasonable.""Hmph, when you fled privately, did you ever think about trying to reason with me?"" Emperor Yan Wen's cold voice came. Xiao Lan was frightened on the spot. She turned around and saw Emperor Yan Wen sitting in the carriage, staring at her coldly. Kong Shilan did not expect to alarm the emperor, and was so frightened that he knelt down and saluted. Before his knees even hit the ground, Chen Diaosi helped him up: "Miss Kong, your majesty is going on tour incognito, so there is no need to salute.After finishing speaking, Chen Diaosi cupped his hands towards Xiao Lan and said, "Your Highness, please go back to your home.""Xiao Lan did not dare to disobey her father's words, so she could only hang her head and said: "Sister Lan, I will go back first, and I will play with you in a few days.But the emperor looked at Kong Shilan and said, "Little girl, I heard that you are going to hold a Shenyuan poetry meeting to resist my proposed marriage?""Kong Shilan's delicate body stiffened slightly, and then she bowed and said: "Your Majesty, my daughter... I want to make the decision on my own regarding my daughter's marriage."Making the decision yourself?""Emperor Yan Wen narrowed his eyes slightly. Kong Shilan bit her thin lips. Marriage is a major matter, and her parents ordered the matchmaker to say it, not to mention that it was His Majesty's marriage. She knew how rebellious her words were. But Kong Shilan still firmed up her thoughts and said: "Yes, I want to make my own decision about my daughter's marriage."Father, just let him make the decision on Sister Lan's marriage.""Xiao Lan pretended to be out of breath from coughing, and said: "My father is proposing a marriage, and I don't know what the other person's character is. What if Sister Lan doesn't get along well with the proposing marriage?Emperor Yan Wen glared at Xiao Lan, ignored his daughter's poor acting skills, and said, "What if we marry Tang Yi?""Xiao Lan suddenly raised her head, eh? That's the father of my child. Kong Shilan felt a little hesitant in her heart, but she quickly firmed up: "I still say what I said, I want to make my own decisions about my daughter's marriage.Emperor Yanwen laughed when he heard this. He tapped the edge of the carriage lightly with his fingertips, and then said after a moment: "Okay, I'm sure."Since it is going to be done, Shen Yuan Poetry Association should not use your name, but use your grandfather’s name!"If we make it bigger, it's best to invite all the wealthy and powerful people in Kyoto to be present.""Moreover, I also promise you that after Shen Yuan's poetry meeting is over, I will take back my promise and will no longer propose marriage to you.""Kong Shilan's heart suddenly turned upside down and she was extremely shocked. His grandfather is the current leader of the literary world in Dayan, and more than half of the officials in Dayan are his students. In his name, all the dignitaries and wealthy families in Kyoto will be present. But what she doesn't understand is why the emperor would do this? "I will also come in person!"Hearing this, Kong Shilan's head suddenly buzzed. The emperor will also come in person! In a sense, her Shenyuan Poetry Recital was a demonstration to force the emperor to break off the engagement... As a result, the emperor agreed to her demonstration? Not only that, but he also endorsed her personally? What on earth is going on here? "My lord... thank you, Your Majesty."Kong Shilan gave a blessing. If you can't figure it out, then go back and ask your grandfather for advice. "Kong Shilan, don't regret it!Emperor Yanwen lowered the curtain and the carriage drove away from Rouge Tower. Xiao Lan became anxious when he saw it: "Father, I haven't gotten in the carriage yet. What will I do if you leave?""The driver from your princess mansion has already arrived, waiting for them to take you back.""The voice of Emperor Yan Wen came indifferently. Kong Shilan stood there, still with deep confusion on his face. Regret? Regret for what? She didn't want to accept His Majesty's proposed marriage and wanted to seek happiness on her own. What was there to regret?
title_en: Chapter 34: Kissing and touching is also called healing?
